memberdef.argsstring: (TimeStepperBuilder const &time_stepper, LogicalToPhysicalMapping const &mapping, IdxRangeBatched const &idx_range, RThetaAdvectionBuilder const &builder, RThetaAdvectionEvaluator const &evaluator, Coord< X_pC, Y_pC > coord_centre=Coord< X_pC, Y_pC >(0, 0), double epsilon=1e-12)
memberdef.name: make_polar_foot_finder

briefdescription.para: Construct a PolarFootFinder, deducing all type template parameters from the arguments.

detaileddescription.para: FFSpace and AFSpace must still be provided explicitly (they are enum values, not types). All remaining template parameters are deduced from the function arguments, eliminating the need for decltype at the call site.

parameterdescription.para: A builder for the time integration method.
The mapping from the logical domain to the physical domain.
The batched index range over which the operator works (used only for type deduction; its value is not forwarded to the constructor).
The spline builder for the advection field coefficients.
The spline evaluator for the advection field.
The polar-centre coordinate in pseudo-Cartesian space.
